provenance.construction: Polynomial-minor CSS code from arXiv:2610.19459 (Nourozi, Smarandache, Mitchell), their Eqs. (10)-(11) at parameters of our own: over R_N = F_2[x]/(x^N+1), H_X(x) = [[a^top, b^top, c^top],[d^top, e^top, f^top]] with d = x^t c, e = a, f = b, and H_Z(x) = [b^2+ac, ab+x^t c^2, a^2+x^t bc]; N = 105, t = 0, a = x^5 u, b = c = x^9 u with u = (x^105+1)/(x^21+1). Not one of the paper's 13 Table I instances, which stop at N = 85; found by sweeping designed divisors of x^N+1 and sampling sparse multiples with the paper's section IV-C residue method.
